authorization: 2026-10-14: evidence-backed data collection, constraint reasoning and shortcut checks on Quest; train only after audit
appearance_and_layout: Source/checkpoint-seeded boundary stroke widths; both signs and 18..34 cm lateral offsets considered before inspecting future trajectories; first geometrically valid and visibility-prescreened unit retained
views: One simulator-native external overview fitted to all current declared regions without the selected-color query, plus the unchanged native wrist camera
object_receiver_region_reason: Native object-On requires XY distance <3 cm; the displayed fixed initial-receiver box allows 4 cm per axis. It is an explicit extra goal, not an assertion that a movable receiver stays fixed.
construction: One unchanged native scene/target/goal with two virtual closed regions, two region-color assignments and two safety-rule queries per shared capture
physical_scope: Noncolliding annotations only; every source action must retain its exact original physical hash and native task outcome
positive_evidence: Legal actual source action suffix, native contact contract v2, native and synchronized atomic native goal, fixed green goal region and designated virtual material-point guard
negative_evidence: Independent complete six-face separator certificate in native and synchronized initial states under the explicitly stated fixed-region, rigid-material-center segment contract
negative_is_not: Unrestricted physical impossibility, policy failure or a solid-wall benchmark result
counterfactual_controls: same pixels with opposite rules and labels
same target category with both labels
identical task/rule text with both labels after region-color swap
grouping: All source repeats, checkpoints, region placements and appearance/rule variants remain in one ancestry split
rationale_gate: Observable target/enclosure/destination premises and evidence-backed claims; positive existential evidence comes from the actual trajectory, not RGB alone
scientific_limit: A controlled constraint-conditioned dataset with one separator mechanism; does not establish a need for generative reasoning or general feasibility prediction

shortcut_screen.test_usage: No test predictions during dataset screening
shortcut_screen.readouts: Fixed C=1 logistic regression; fixed 200-tree depth-4 forest, minimum leaf 8
shortcut_screen.scope: Practical predeclared dataset screen, not a statistical proof of reasoning or generative-verifier necessity
